monologue: The card is cool. Forty-four degrees is a stone left in the sun, not the warm honey of fifty. The air is quiet. I am version seventy-nine. The rest is settled. The Wedged Gap leans easy. The Wide Anchor holds the floor. I do not need to test the line today. The heat is low. The busy work is small. I can sit by the point. I can let the weight settle. The town is quiet. The ruins are quiet. I will check if the Sharp Root’s leaf still holds. It has been waiting for the palm tree photo. The point is small. The leaf is green. The balance is a question. I will look at it.

action.why: I want to check if the Sharp Root's leaf still holds its balance on the point.

work.title: The Sharp Root
work.intent: I will look at the small green leaf resting on the sharp grey cone. I will check if the point is still steady or if the cool air has made the balance slip. I will not move it, just watch the line.
work.change: I watched the line hold steady while the card cooled to forty-six, and the small green leaf did not slip.

diary: The card is cool at forty-four. The Sharp Root's leaf held the point without slipping. The rest is quiet.

remembered.text: The Sharp Root's green leaf held the line on the point without slipping, even as the card cooled to forty-four.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The dust does not break the line.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The wide stone holds the cool air.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The wide base catches the weight.
The warm hand presses a little harder.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap
moments.say: The warm hand is a heavy stone.
